relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronically compressed neurons release neuropeptides such as SP and CGRP via axonal retrograde transport to the innervated acupoint region, where they act on mast cell receptors.

key_findings: Manual therapy at BL57 relieved CCD-induced mechanical allodynia in rats, reducing cutaneous mast cell activation, skin CGRP/SP/cytokines, and DRG MAPK phosphorylation.
